deepdive.sec: Power T&D EPC (Transmission & Distribution turnkey + tower/conductor manufacturing)

bull_bear.body:
- Net debt cut 30% to INR 274 cr (INR 181 cr ex-IPO funds); OCF doubled (~INR 816 cr from 415 cr).
- WC days 81 (from 91), targeting sub-80; finance-cost/revenue improved 55 bps.
- Trade acceptances ~INR 1,200 cr — to stay broadly flat; uses RXIL/VFS for credit.
- 100% dividend (INR 2/sh); ROCE 25.79% (>24% for 3yrs).
bull_bear.title: 9 Capital allocation

bull_bear.body:
- Geopolitical / supply-chain disruption (Feb-Mar) deferring execution & inflating costs (fuel, shipping, insurance) — primary reason for pruned FY27 guidance.
- Order-inflow miss (INR 8,520 cr vs ~10,000 cr target) — slippage risk into Q1 FY27.
- Lumpy quarterly revenue (project lifecycle) — Q4 de-growth; not to be read QoQ.
- Labour demand-supply tightness (managed via training/loyalty programs).
- Right-of-way / forest / statutory clearance delays (client-side; covered by EOT).
- Rising competition from road-EPC entrants into T&D (mgmt won't chase volume at lower margin).
- Margin compression to ~11% (lowest profile since ~Mar'22 per an analyst).
bull_bear.title: 10 Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Confident, disciplined, candid. Consistently met/beat guidance (delivered 30% vs guided 25-27%). Emphasizes "fair and prudent" guidance, selective bidding, risk-managed (MDB-funded preference). Deflects QoQ scrutiny toward annual numbers; transparent on order-inflow miss and tax/finance-cost queries (some bookkeeping items deferred to IR). 42-year operating history cited repeatedly.
bull_bear.title: 11 Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body:
- Q4 weakness is structural to project cycle (20 projects closed in Dec = high-margin closures front-loaded into H1), NOT demand loss — revenue "deferred not lost."
- The ~11% margin guide bakes in commodity inflation AND the fact only ~35% of book has pass-through; upside is real if supply chain normalizes.
- New INR 203 cr capex is construction-equipment-led — a tell that execution productivity (not capacity) is now the binding constraint on the 20-25% growth ambition.
- Backward integration (own conductors/towers, full PQs) is the moat vs road-EPC new entrants.
- SEB/TBCB is a large untapped optionality (~20% of pipeline) management is deliberately under-exposed to.
bull_bear.title: 12 Non-obvious takeaways

bull_bear.body:
- Credit profile improving: "India Ratings upgraded credit rating to IND AA-/Stable in August 2026, reflecting the Company's strengthened business and financial profile"; the rating table also shows CRISIL AA-/Stable long-term and CRISIL A1+ / IND A1+ short-term.
- Borrowings at 30 Jun 2026: LT Borrowings Rs 58.92 cr (vs Rs 88.53 cr at 31 Mar 2026), ST Borrowings Rs 716.97 cr (vs Rs 572.23 cr), cash and cash equivalents Rs 228.18 cr (vs Rs 393.77 cr), IPO Funds Rs 81.29 cr (vs Rs 92.79 cr), giving "Net Debt with IPO Funds" of Rs 466.42 cr vs Rs 174.2 cr - an increase of Rs 292.22 cr in the quarter.
- The balance-sheet chart carries a different net-debt series: Net Debt of 480 / 533 / 502 / 267 / 548 (Rs cr) for FY23 / FY24 / FY25 / FY26 / Q1FY27, with Net Debt to EBITDA of 1.63 / 1.12 / 0.74 / 0.33 / 0.67 - the Q1FY27 figure of 548 differs from the borrowings table's "Net Debt with IPO Funds" of 466.42, and the deck does not reconcile the two.
- Return on Capital Employed: 18.27% (FY23), 24.33% (FY24), 24.70% (FY25), 25.76% (FY26), 23.58% (Q1FY27); Debt to Equity: 0.78x, 0.56x, 0.34x, 0.29x, 0.32x over the same periods.
- Working Capital Days: 53 (FY23), 73 (FY24), 91 (FY25), 81 (FY26), 85 (Q1FY27); the deck notes "Previous period figures are restated wherever applicable".
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- Power T&D ~90% of revenue; substations <5% (smaller part).
- Geographic split ~50/50 domestic/international.
- Backward integration: own tower + conductor manufacturing — a differentiator most new competitors lack.
- During FY26: completed seven 765 kV transmission projects in India; supplied >1,50,000 MT towers, 4,000 km conductors; entered Abu Dhabi, Tunisia, Djibouti, Botswana.

business.title: 13 Challenges → beneficiaries & losers

business.body:
- Self-described as "A differentiated T&D platform with scale, manufacturing integration and legacy", resting on six stated strengths: operational prowess, experienced leadership, backward integration, design & engineering excellence, execution track record and order-book visibility.
- Backward integration is the stated moat: "Towers, conductors and poles manufactured in-house for quality and reliability", plus "In-house design, engineering and testing capabilities" - described as "Fully backward-integrated manufacturing platform delivering end-to-end control from design to dispatch".
- Scale credentials: "4 decades+ of expertise", "64 countries" with "Footprints across six continents", "2,800+ Employees", and "20,500+ Man-months of design & engineering experience".
- Order-book visibility claimed as "More than 2.3 times orderbook to revenue ratio", with a "Balanced business and geographic mix enhances long-term revenue visibility".
- International franchise is anchored in Africa - "Footprint in over 28 African countries across all regions of Africa" - with "Projects funded by global agencies such as World Bank, AfDB, EBID, KfW, and BOAD", i.e. multilateral/ICB-funded work rather than purely domestic bidding.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Acquisition] "Acquisition of Gactel Turnkey Projects, strengthening cooling tower EPC capabilities" - listed as a Q1 FY27 strategic highlight, with no consideration, stake or timeline disclosed in the deck.
- [Order book] Total un-executed order book of Rs 16,035 cr as on 30th June 2026 "including L1 of Rs. 400 cr"; a separate order-book pie on the same slide is labelled Rs 15,635 cr "as of June 2026". Closing order book trend: Rs 5,908 cr (FY22), 9,619 (FY23), 10,100 (FY24), 14,551 (FY25), 16,313 (FY26).
- [Chart binding lost] The order-book slide shows two domestic/international splits - "41% / 59% Domestic - International -" and "63% / 37% Domestic - International -" - but the extraction does not preserve which split belongs to Q1 FY27 order inflow and which to the un-executed order book, so neither is asserted here.
- [Labour code] The 5-year PAT chart is footnoted "PAT excludes provision made of Rs 17 Cr in Q3 FY26 towards new labour code" and shows FY26 PAT of 421, while the P&L table reports FY26 Profit After Tax of 404 with an exceptional item of 17 that "includes the impact of additional provision as per new labour code"; both readings are in the deck.
- [Industry backdrop] India: "National Electricity plan - 191,000 CKM of Transmission lines addition by 2032 which is 38% of India's total grid"; "Rs 9.15 lakh crore transmission investments planned by 2032"; "500 GW non-fossil capacity target by 2030" and a "Target for 2036 - 900GW Renewable Energy"; government "working for integrating 1150 kV UHV lines". Global: "Global electricity demand expected to nearly double by 2050" and Africa's "Mission 300 to connect 300 million people to electricity".
- [Leadership] Executive Chairman Digambar Bagde is "the Promoter of our Company", started Transrail in 1984 and has five decades of experience; MD & CEO Randeep Narang has over 35 years of experience, previously COO (West) at Bharti Airtel, MD & CEO of CEAT Kelani Holdings Sri Lanka, and most recently President-International (T&D, Solar) & Cables at KEC International.
business.title: Notable from the deck

latest_quarter.body:
- FY26 margin 11.92% within guided 11.5-12%; FY25 was 12.7% (mgmt insists not apples-to-apples — project mix/geography driven).
- Q4 RM cost % rose sharply on commodity inflation + March supply-chain disruption.
- ~30-35% of contracts have price-variation (pass-through) clauses; rest fixed → margin exposure to commodity inflation.
- Finance cost ~INR 210-220 cr; LC discounting + interest blended 8.5-9% (LC charges ~INR 40-50 cr); expects 50-100 bps reduction next year.
- Claims best/one-of-best margin profile in T&D industry.
latest_quarter.title: 7 Margins & cost dynamics

latest_quarter.body:
**This quarter (Q4 FY26):** FY26 closed +30% rev (beat 25-27% guide), record EBITDA INR 820 cr / PAT INR 421 cr; net debt -30% to INR 274 cr; OCF doubled; WC days 91→81; order book up to INR 16,361 cr; capacity more-than-doubled; new INR 203 cr construction-equipment capex approved; FY27 guide set at 20-22% rev / ~11% EBITDA / INR 10-11k cr inflow; INR 2/sh dividend. Order inflow missed (8,520 vs ~10,000 cr).

**Next-quarter watch items:** (1) Q1 FY27 order conversion from the ~INR 10,000 cr bid; (2) completion of IPO Phase-1 capex (tower 1,96,000 MTPA + conductor doubling) by Q2 FY27 and CWIP capitalization; (3) Bangladesh Phase-2 completion/closure (3-6 months); (4) whether supply-chain/geopolitical pressure eases (margin upside trigger); (5) finance-cost/LC reduction (50-100 bps); (6) whether order inflow recovers toward 10-11k cr run-rate.
latest_quarter.title: QoQ change log

outlook.body:
- FY27 revenue growth **20-22%** (off larger INR 6,880 cr base); upside to 22%+ if geopolitics/supply chain stabilize.
- FY27 EBITDA margin **~11%** (down from 11.92%); steady-state 3yr target ~11-12%.
- FY27 order inflow **INR 10,000-11,000 cr**.
- Q1/quarter-level: management refuses explicit Q1 guidance — says assume annualized rate; "first quarter will be stable." Bid ~INR 10,000 cr in Q1 already, awaiting results.
- 3-year vision: grow at ~20-25% CAGR; ROCE maintained ~25%; WC days toward sub-80.
outlook.title: 3 Guidance (incl. next quarter)

outlook.body:
- Unexecuted order book INR 16,361 cr (incl. L1), up from 14,551 cr → >2 years revenue visibility.
- Mix: ~90% Power T&D, ~10% other (civil/poles/railways); domestic ~50% / international ~50%.
- International: Africa ~20% of order book; Bangladesh ~3-4% (Phase 1 done, Phase 2 to close in 3-4 months / project closure ~6 months).
- Bid pipeline: India INR 80,000 cr-1,00,000 cr opportunity; international ~INR 50,000 cr — "not diminished." Targeting 10-12% market share. Bid ~INR 6,000 cr last quarter, ~INR 10,000 cr this quarter.
outlook.title: 4 Order book & pipeline

outlook.body:
- HVDC projects upcoming — part of multi-year cycle (>2,00,000 km lines to be added; >INR 9,00,000 cr investment outlook over 5 years).
- State Electricity Boards moving to TBCB route — up to ~20% opportunity but Transrail currently only 3-4% SEB revenue; will participate selectively on risk matrix (none bid yet).
- Multilateral-development-bank-funded international projects (preferred for risk management).
- Construction-productivity capex (new INR 203 cr) to improve execution speed.
outlook.title: 6 Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: Best-ever year (rev +30%, record EBITDA/PAT, ROCE ~26%, net debt -30%) on a multi-year T&D capex supercycle; FY27 guidance deliberately pruned to 20-22% revenue / ~11% EBITDA on geopolitical supply-chain caution, with >2yr order-book runway and capacity more-than-doubled.
